name: project-kit
description: Production-grade project workflow for any stack: resumable task tracking, test-first builds with real E2E tests, design-to-UI fidelity, security gates, and releases, including Claude Code skills, plugins, and MCP servers and clients. Works alongside superpowers, impeccable, ponytail, token-router, and stack plugins.

setup.title: Setup on session start
setup.description: What to do when Claude Code starts at the root of a git repository that project-kit hasn't set up. ask: Claude offers /project-kit:kickoff once. auto: install the project layer with the detected apps (never over an existing CLAUDE.md). off: nothing.
